response.instructions: NextRole helps you review and tailor your CV for a role. ats_lint runs a free, deterministic ATS check on a CV. tailor_cv_to_role rewrites a CV for a specific job spec. Results link back to nextrole.site to save, track, and refine.

tools.name: ats_lint
tools.title: ATS lint a CV
tools.description: Free, deterministic ATS check: flags banned symbols, first-person voice, non-standard headers, and unquantified bullets. Returns findings + a pass/fail verdict.

tools.name: tailor_cv_to_role
tools.title: Tailor a CV to a job
tools.description: Rewrites a CV for a specific job spec using NextRole's multi-pass tailor→critic engine. Free anonymous allowance; on exhaustion returns a link to continue on the web app.

tools.name: score_cv
tools.title: Score a CV against a job
tools.description: The free first read: scores a CV against a job spec using NextRole's critic engine — overall match and per-dimension scores on a 1–10 scale, strengths, gaps, and the single top priority to fix. Scores describe CV-to-role fit; hiring outcomes depend on the employer.

tools.name: find_roles
tools.title: Find live roles
tools.description: Searches live job listings for a role query (e.g. "frontend engineer London"). Cheap, no LLM — returns a short list of matching roles with company and link.

query.description: A role query, e.g. "frontend engineer London".

tools.name: fetch_job_spec
tools.title: Fetch a job spec from a URL
tools.description: Fetches and extracts the job description text from a public job-posting URL, ready to feed into score_cv or tailor_cv_to_role. Cheap, no LLM.

url.description: A public https:// job posting URL.

content.text:
Match score: 5.9/10.
Top priority: Rewrite the incident-recovery bullet to show production troubleshooting with a concrete outcome, using the exact JD phrase, and add a metric to the pytest bullet, only where the candidate's real experience supports it.

Tailor this CV to the role, then save and track at https://nextrole.site/?utm_source=mcp&utm_medium=mcp_server&utm_campaign=score_cv

strengths: Top-third summary names Python and PostgreSQL, which are the core stack in the JD, and the role title matches.
The query optimisation bullet is quantified (12s to 3s) and covers the required SQL query optimisation skill.
Pytest coverage and collaboration with product colleagues map directly to the JD's automated testing and product collaboration duties.
gaps: Production troubleshooting is only implied by 'documented incident recovery steps'. Rewrite that bullet in the Experience section to state what was diagnosed and fixed, using the exact phrase 'production troubleshooting', only if it is true.
'REST API design' is not an exact match. The CV has 'REST APIs' in Skills and 'Python APIs' in Experience. Use 'REST API design' wording if the candidate actually did design work.
Only 2 of 4 bullets are quantified (about 50%). Add real metrics to the testing bullet (such as coverage %) and to the incident bullet (such as recovery time), but only where the figures exist.
There is no evidence of code review or mentoring. Add them only if they actually happened. Kubernetes and AWS are absent and should not be invented.

The summary is generic. Add 'clear technical communication' and 'SQL query optimisation' to the summary so the top third echoes the JD's required terms, if they are supported by the candidate's experience.
